scope: Bounded static producer traces for loadout requests, perfect dodge and resources, and encounter requests. Research evidence only; no callable ABI, public capability, transaction, or isolation guarantee.

evidence: The debug preset setter returns zero immediately and performs no loadout mutation.
The UI loadout queue signature includes LoadoutRequests/LoadoutSlots, melee unlock loadout/data, charm data, and unlock database inputs.
The variable ability-loadout handler at 0x2981030 processes 16-byte request entries, validates individual entries, and then writes slot state or invokes equip helpers before advancing.
At 0x2981231 and 0x2981263 it clears selected slot identifiers; fixed requests at 0x2981330 instead update slot flags from an 8-byte request list.
missing: Whole-preset validation and atomic commit or verified rollback across all equipment domains.
Authoritative unlocked-item/talent semantics without purchase or progression side effects.
Authoritative safe location and combat restrictions plus loadout-owned request completion acknowledgement.

evidence: The ghost-volume callback at 0x269a480 reads real damage receiver entries and perfect-dodge detection state, validates target generation and performs faction/geometry checks before success effects at 0x2699840.
The success helper publishes Lua event key 0x1a1acbcd with two vector-tagged payload values. These values are not established as unique attack or hit identifiers.
The normalized ability-resource binding resolves component hash 0x59f99e92 with entity stride 0x350, reading maximum at +8 and current at +0xc.

The native request handler at 0x21e3e90 invokes additive helper 0x21e34a0. It selects a 0x108-byte resource slot, may modify the requested amount through a status hook, adds to current at +0xc, clamps to maximum at +8, and records accounting/flags.
The distinct helper at 0x21e31f0 subtracts resource; it is not a credit helper.
missing: Unique attack and successful player melee-hit receipts with attribution and occurrence time.
Deduplication across repeated damage entries, detection volumes, targets, and event delivery.
Reviewed resource-slot meaning, exact credit semantics after modifiers, and scheduler-safe request ownership/acknowledgement.
A once-only conditional ten-percent-of-maximum credit transaction tied to the qualifying event.

evidence: Start writes a request word at state +0xa. Stop/despawn set stop/request mode fields; these are requests rather than synchronous completion operations.
The despawn callback at 0x2658aa0 reads a 0x60-byte EncounterState, passes mode +6 to helper 0x2658750, then clears that mode byte. Clearing the request does not acknowledge descendant cleanup.
The despawn query names EncounterEntry, GlobalID, Dead, SeizedEntity and DitherDespawn; ownership of spawned projectiles, effects and deferred requests is not established.
The completion binding calls 0x264a580, which resolves an encounter-state entry, writes its value and sets state byte +4. Its name must not be treated as an isolated practice API.
missing: An isolated practice encounter lifecycle separated from campaign progression and rewards.
Authoritative original-state capture and restoration across death, reload, cancellation and failures.
Reviewed spawn identity, save/quest side effects and safe reset barriers.
